name: Captions
description: Use when adding or fixing captions or subtitles: words that match what was said, pages short enough to read, placed away from faces and platform buttons, and a sidecar file when the platform takes one.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
